description: Cross-language wire contract for the X-Grid-* cross-cutting request-context headers (backlog T3-9). TS: frontends/ui/src/lib/request-context.ts's buildGridRequestContextHeaders(case.input) must equal case.headers. Python: aiq_agent.project_context.GridRequestContext.from_headers(case.headers) must equal the case.input-equivalent fields. A path that forgets to forward one of these headers, or that encodes it differently, fails this fixture instead of silently degrading in production. Base64url payloads below are computed with Node's Buffer.toString('base64url') (unpadded) — the exact encoding server.js / header-encoding.ts / request-context.ts use; the Python decoder re-pads before decoding.

cases.name: full_authenticated_project_context
cases.comment: Every field populated: authenticated org member in a project-scoped chat with org model overrides, a live budget snapshot, org-disabled web_search, and memory reflection on.

input.projectContext:
Project: Acme widget audit
Focus: supply chain resilience
input.projectMemory:
- Prefers concise citations
- Based in Germany

cases.name: anonymous_minimal_scope
cases.comment: REQUIRE_AUTH=false / anonymous single-tenant deployment: no org, no user, no project — only the base collection scope and an explicit reflection-off flag survive.

cases.name: project_scoped_no_overrides_no_budget
cases.comment: Authenticated project-scoped request where model-overrides/budget/disabled-sources lookups returned nothing (org has no active override config, budget lookup skipped) — those headers must be OMITTED, not sent empty/null.

input.projectContext:
Multi-line
context
value with unicode: café

envelopeCases.name: signed_envelope_full_context
envelopeCases.comment: Same input as the full_authenticated_project_context case above, minted as the consolidated signed X-Grid-Request-Context envelope instead of individual headers. TS: buildGridRequestContextEnvelope(case.input, case.secret) must equal {header: case.header, signature: case.signature}. Python: GridRequestContext.from_envelope(case.header, case.signature, case.secret) must reproduce the input-equivalent fields, and a wrong secret/signature must make it return None (treated as absent). envelopeJson is the exact raw JSON string signed and base64url-encoded, included for readability/debugging — both sides derive header/signature from it, not the other way around.

envelopeCases.name: signed_envelope_minimal_scope
envelopeCases.comment: Same input as the anonymous_minimal_scope case above, minted as an envelope. Exercises the case where most fields are omitted from the payload entirely (falsy/empty-array omission rules identical to buildGridRequestContextHeaders) -- including bundesland, pinning the envelope-WITHOUT-bundesland case (backlog T3-9 follow-up, 2026-07-16).

envelopeCases.name: signed_envelope_with_bundesland
envelopeCases.comment: Backlog T3-9 follow-up (2026-07-16, user-mandated): jurisdiction rides the envelope as a validated structured field (`bundesland`), a parallel channel alongside the unchanged `bundesland=<token>` line inside `projectContext` (still read by the LLM). `bundesland` is appended as the LAST payload key (fixed key order) so the signed bytes of every pre-existing case above stay byte-identical after this field was added -- ENVELOPE-ONLY: unlike every other field there is no individual `X-Grid-Bundesland` header (see request-context.ts's module docstring / aiq_agent.project_context's module docstring for why).
